label: TestPay · Card payment (auth)
description: Single card authorization: send an auth request to RestPay. This is the unit transaction the Load Test drives under the steady / ramp / spike profiles — mirrors the TestPay console's SimpleTestStrategy / payment flow.

label: TestPay · Refund
description: Authorize, then refund by RRN. The refund references the original auth's retrieval reference number — mirrors the TestPay RefundTestStrategy.

label: TestPay · Reversal pair
description: Payment followed by a reversal of that same transaction (reversal references the original RRN) — mirrors the TestPay ReversalTestStrategy, which sends payment + reversal pairs.

label: TestPay · Heartbeat / echo
description: Connection keepalive / liveness probe against RestPay. This is the unit the Soak (heartbeat) load profile holds open across many long-lived connections — mirrors the TestPay HeartbeatTestStrategy.

label: TestPay · ISO 8583 purchase + reversal
description: 0200 financial request then 0420 reversal advice over the TCP/ISO 8583 switch link, the reversal correlated by RRN. ISO variant of the reversal test for switch-facing load.

label: payShield · CVV generate + verify
description: HSM host-command flow against the payShield 10K simulator: generate a CVK (A0), generate a CVV for a card with it (CW), then verify that CVV (CY). Each step chains the previous response. Run against the payshield-sim environment.

label: payShield · PIN verify (PVV)
description: HSM interchange PIN verification against the payShield 10K simulator: verify a customer PIN block under a ZPK using the Visa PVV method (EC). Supply zpk, pvk, pin_block, pan, pvki and pvv. Run against the payshield-sim environment.
